item.title: Trying Out Personal Agents
item.description:
There’s a new wave of personal agents: agents connected to your email, calendar and accounts that do things on your behalf. Depending on who you read, they’re “claws” (after OpenClaw), “always-on agents”, “proactive agents”, or AI assistants that live in your text messages. There’s OpenClaw, xAI’s Grok Bot, Meta’s Muse, OpenAI’s Dots, Nous Research’s Hermes Agent, Instinct, and Anthropic’s Claude Duet on the way.

My own version

Like many early adopters of AI, I have a very elaborate, home-rolled equivalent to these. For me it’s Claude Code, and it helps me run my business (and most aspects of my life at this point). It has access to my email accounts and calendars through a connector I wrote (well, asked Claude to write).
